a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate until 8) almost certainly ends with both of us dead in round 1, holding 0 cells. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than let them go unused. I'm telling you openly so you can plan around it rather than be surprised. If we both take, the split is random. If the storm spares us, I'll operate every round after that to help refill the reserve for you.
